reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.comment:
My daughter bought a gaming computer on sale. The catch was it only had 8GB ram, but did have another channel open. I researched a little and found this, which was on sale at a good price and it had already received some good reviews. I purchased this hoping that it would work well. While her computer was already working well and gaming pretty nicely, there were some memory issues that were knocking her out of games at times. Once I received this, I promptly upgraded her computer, which didn’t take long at all. This snapped into place very smoothly and as expected. The computer immediately read this without issue and performance was immediately noticeably improved. Since upgrading the memory with this piece, which runs the same speed as the memory stick that came stock with the computer, the computer has not kicked her out of a game or given her any limitation in gaming or functionality due to RAM. This has made a noticeable improvement in her computer and was just the perfect solution to get her what she wanted and needed out of a computer without frustration.
Overall, I highly recommend. Yes, this is affordable and that gave me some pause, too. I saw the reviews and decided to give it a try and I have not been disappointed. Just make sure that this at least runs the speed of the ram you are replacing or matching (or that it runs faster) and I feel that you will not have regrets. I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Works great for my Intel NUC8i5BEH and less in price than other name brands
reviews.comment:
Wanted 32GB dual channel memory for an intel NUC8i5BEH, took a chance on this, and glad because it works great.  I probably should have gotten the 64GB option, but do not need that much memory at this time.  No compatibility issues, no problems with memtest86 for 24 hours, and have been using it without any problems for 2 weeks (will update review if I run into any future problems).
Pros:
-Price was less than other major name brands new/used(ebay) and this 3200mhz speed was cheaper than the DDR4-2400mhz 1.2V SO-DIMM spec that Intel states I should be using.
-Free overnight shipping via Amazon prime as well easy return if there was a problem.
-Lifetime warranty for additional assurances
-No issues with stress testing with memtest86 for 24 hours and real world very heavy use for the past two weeks.
Cons:
-(Not really a con, but ..) Teamgroup website could not tell me if this was compatible with my intel NUC and couldn't find many supporting reviews, but I took a gamble and it worked out
Other observations:
-My kit was manufactured in 2023-W16 (3 months ago) from when I ordered it and seeing the module manufacturer as Team Group Inc and DRAM manufacturer as SK Hynix according to CPU-z in Windows and other tools in Linux.
-Probably should have gotten the 64GB kit for a little more.
